evidence.claim: Glassdoor says the personal data it collects varies with how you interact with its services.
Glassdoor says it uses cookies to deliver, evaluate and improve advertising, including using data about you to provide relevant advertising on and off its services.
Glassdoor says it works with third parties such as Google Analytics to measure advertising performance and track traffic.
Glassdoor points to a cookie settings tool in the footer or settings of its websites.
Glassdoor says retention periods are based on criteria including legal retention periods, litigation, contract requirements and the expected lifetime of user use.
Glassdoor says it uses cookies and data about you for relevant advertising on and off its services and works with third-party analytics such as Google Analytics.

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 13.11.0 (report dated Sept. 18, 2026) found code signatures for 4 known tracker SDK(s): Amplitude (analytics profiling), AppsFlyer (analytics), Google CrashLytics (crash reporting), OpenTelemetry (OpenCensus, OpenTracing) (analytics). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
